notes: Steps 1 to 5 pass: research article (p. 1); proposes A-FedCS, a count-sketch gradient compression with analog AirComp aggregation, truncated channel inversion and server-side top-k with error accumulation (pp. 2-7); the learned element is the CNN trained across devices (p. 8), so no_learning does not apply; the problem is the over-the-air aggregation itself (area 7). Step 6 (system) applies: p. 4, Section II-B, 'Hm is the S x N channel gain matrix from device m to the PS' and 'Xm is the S x N complex signal', with S subchannels and N timeslots, so each device and the parameter server see one scalar channel per resource element (no antenna dimension, no spatial processing) and no RIS is used. MIMO and RIS are mentioned only as other settings studied in the literature (p. 1, citing [24]). Results are quantitative (test accuracy on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR10, pp. 8-13), so the paper is excluded only for its single-antenna link.
